senses.definition: (uncountable) A dessert made from frozen sweetened cream or a similar substance, usually flavoured.
examples: Strawberries are particularly delicious with ice cream.
We were having a chocolate ice cream.

quotes.text: There’s a good chance you’ve heard of the Ninja Creami by now. The original version of the ice cream maker has been around since 2021, but thanks to TikTok, it’s been one of the buzziest kitchen appliances lately.
quotes.reference: 2025 July 11, Amina Lake Patel, “I’ve used the Ninja Creami Deluxe ice cream maker that’s all over TikTok for a year. Here’s my review”, in CNN:

senses.definition: (countable) A portion of ice cream on a stick, in a cup or in a wafer cone.
examples: Can I have some money for an ice cream, Mum?
